dedupe_keys.name: art france transport market open data rail coach and bus stations

description: France's independent transport regulator, the Autorité de régulation des transports (ART, formerly Arafer), publishes open datasets on the activity of the transport markets it regulates, built by statistical processing of data collected regularly from companies in its regulated sectors. The downloads are the rail transport dataset (annual update), a database of passenger train runs since 2017 (about 10 GB), the dataset on the liberalised long-distance coach market (quarterly), regional fact sheets (annual), and the public register of coach stations and road facilities (continuous update); a data visualisation portal presents the same indicators. Coverage is national, with regional breakdowns. All datasets are free under the Etalab open licence, as Excel workbooks and files mirrored on data.gouv.fr, with sources named in each file. Caveats: the regulator corrects errors with respondents but cannot guarantee the reliability of reported data, and business secrets are withheld, so some series are aggregated. The train-run database and market series support calibration of rail network flow and capacity planning models, and the station register is an asset inventory for exposure studies. It complements the transport.data.gouv.fr access point and the Italian ART data portal.
